messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Act as a hostile but constructive architecture examiner. Preserve sovereign settlement boundaries, separate established mathematics from thesis and conjecture, and design the smallest falsifiable cycle. Do not assume an implementation exists.

Extract the smallest decisive RSI MAPE-K cycle from this combined research program. Established local prior art: a gyrobifastigial Chu–Hoare complex uses a twisted polyhedral cell complex for territory, local FOUR-valued Chu evaluation, Hoare/lax-Chu seam contracts, connection/transport, cycle holonomy/Burgers defects, protected-border classification, and markets as selective local relaxation. Existing audit warns that Chu is not itself a tiling; zero Burgers does not imply no defects; rotational holonomy, cancellation, poor coefficients, and protected nonzero borders need countermodels. New contact thesis: testimony is modeled as a contact manifold, law as Legendrian, institutional time as Reeb flow of a price-of-saying form; arbitrage-as-overtwisted and liturgy-as-Weinstein are conjectures, not theorems about institutions. Protocol thesis: consensus is only for circuit residues/holonomy. An enterprise retains private data and publishes only a Merkle commitment to a FOUR-valued Chu matrix of capabilities × obligations. A bilateral contract is a committed Chu commuting square: each party writes only its half, and an EVM verifier checks two Merkle proofs plus equality. Chain stores seams and loop residues, not enterprise state. RMN is proposed to express pure seam laws and detect circuit residues; White nodes verify matrix consistency, Black morphism conformance, Blue adversarially search residue/overtwisted cycles, Red rehearse proposed paths. Later hypotheses price destruction of FOUR alternatives as erasure-gas and trigger epochs after quanta of priced saying rather than wall-clock time. Desired deployment order: commuting-square verifier; residue network; erasure-denominated books; Reeb-like epochs. Existing UOA/SDSS/OSS machinery is days old and may be replaced; use it as provider machinery, not tradition. The persistent goal must increasingly procure Union services, preserve customer acceptance/refusal, avoid shared custody/global state/bridges, and prove immediate cost reductions rather than assume them. Design cycle 1 around two sovereign test settlements and local EVM-compatible chains or one minimal chain if two is not yet justified. Specify exact consensus-visible bytes, off-chain/private bytes, refusal cases, cost baseline, customer evidence, and what would falsify the architecture before widening.

epistemicCorrections: Chu spaces supply morphism structure, not a tiling cover; no geometric coverage argument about territory is licensed by Chu alone — the polyhedral complex must carry that work independently.
Burgers vector zero is necessary but not sufficient for a defect-free circuit; rotational/Frank-type defects require an independent zero-holonomy check and cannot be inferred from Burgers alone.
Arbitrage-as-overtwisted disk is a conjecture mapping a financial phenomenon onto a contact-geometric object; no proof that overtwistedness captures arbitrage semantics exists in the program.
Liturgy-as-Weinstein is a conjecture; Weinstein fillability is a theorem-level claim that requires a proof, not an analogy from institutional regularity.
Reeb flow of a price-of-saying form is a modeling proposal importing contact-Hamiltonian machinery; applicability to institutional time requires verification before any protocol depends on it.
Protected nonzero borders and poor coefficients are identified risks, not impossibility results; countermodels must be constructed before the protocol assumes they cannot arise in any settlement.
RMN node role partition (White/Black/Blue/Red) is a design proposal; whether the four roles together detect all circuit residues is an open completeness question, not an established result.

falsifiers: EVM verifier requires more than the recorded baseline gas per commuting-square check, making the candidate strictly more expensive than the current machinery it is meant to replace.
A Burgers-zero seam produces a nonzero circuit residue that the holonomy classifier emits as zero, demonstrating that the seam contract's defect detection is insufficient for the claimed guarantee.

Two-party Merkle commitment requires a shared pre-image, a shared salt, or a shared key at any point before the verifier runs, introducing hidden shared custody that violates the sovereignty constraint.
A valid customer refusal cannot halt the flow after one party has published its Merkle root, meaning acceptance/refusal is not preserved at the commitment boundary.
FOUR-valued matrix Merkle commitment leaks individual cell values through proof path structure or leaf ordering, violating the private-data boundary even when only the root is published on-chain.

A rotational holonomy countermodel is constructed in which the twisted polyhedral complex fails to cancel the defect, requiring a topology change to the territory model before any holonomy-class claim can be trusted.

A protected-nonzero-border countermodel is found in which a structurally valid settlement permanently holds a nonzero Burgers class, meaning the border-protection criterion is not sufficient to guarantee eventual zero-residue closure.
RMN Blue node finds an overtwisted cycle that the combined White, Black, and Red nodes cannot classify, demonstrating the four-role partition is incomplete with respect to residue detection.

Union procurement requires a bridge, a relay, or any form of shared custody to route payment between the two sovereign test settlements, which the architecture explicitly prohibits and which would block all Union integration.

Erasure-gas pricing, when prototyped in a later cycle, requires a global counter or shared accumulator to compute the price of a destroyed FOUR alternative, reintroducing global state that cycle 1 was designed to eliminate.
unionProcurement: Identify which Union settlement APIs can accept a 32-byte Merkle root as proof of service eligibility in place of full capability-state disclosure, and record whether any API requires raw matrix entries before a measurement is taken.

Verify that Union refusal handling honors a customer veto before any Merkle root is published; if Union requires a root before it processes a refusal, that ordering is a falsifier for the acceptance-preservation constraint.
Measure Union service cost per bilateral cycle against the baseline bilateral cost in cycle 1 before claiming Union reduces costs; do not assume cost reduction without a recorded measurement.

Confirm that Union routing requires no bridge and no shared custody: each sovereign test settlement must sign only its own half of the commuting square and must never hold a key derived from or shared with the other settlement.

Map Union service obligations into FOUR-valued Chu cells so they can be committed in the same Merkle structure used for enterprise obligations, establishing a uniform commitment format that does not require a separate Union-specific on-chain record.

Establish a refusal protocol with Union in which a customer veto issued before the epoch boundary is enforceable without any enterprise state appearing on-chain; if Union cannot honor this, document the gap as a procurement blocker for cycle 2.
